description: Kakao's 2012-present government data-request statistics as one queryable archive — series, latest-report resolution, and workbook mirroring no other tool offers.

novel_features.name: Whole-archive series
novel_features.description: One tidy table of every published half-year since 2012 — requests, processed, and affected accounts per service corporation and request category — instead of 28 separate report lookups.

novel_features.name: Latest-report resolution
novel_features.description: Fetch the newest published half-year without knowing which period it is.

novel_features.name: Workbook link index
novel_features.description: List the official XLSX workbook download URLs (Korean and English editions) for every published half-year.
